focal_entities.receiver: someone who has AI make documents, code and the like, meeting turn for the first time on GitHub

goal_orientation.use: to decide whether to use turn in a step of their own plugin

goal_orientation.acceptance: they can tell whether turn is for them, what they gain, how a step of their plugin uses it from start to result, and what it gives them over the AI checking its own work

constraints.rule: Write only the README's first stage, the opening, Example and Why turn, made from the UX before the design; the sections written once turn is built are left out until then.
